title: 2027 Regulations — HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc
claims: The current regulation page is labelled 2027 Regulations and covers TDS as one of the UTMB, CCC and TDS 100M races.

For TDS, one personal assistant is allowed at designated aid stations, in the reserved area and with a bag of no more than 30 litres; medical help from a crew member is forbidden except small care such as massage or blister treatment while the runner stays seated.
Runners must carry all mandatory equipment for the whole race; missing key safety equipment can lead to disqualification, and random or organised gear checks can occur.
Poles, if used, must be carried from the start and may not be collected during the race or placed in drop bags.
A runner must leave a checkpoint before its cut-off time; dropping out or being stopped requires following the organisation's instructions.

verification.note: Official regulation page read. It is the 2027 edition; the page does not provide a 2026 archive, so the text is used as a rule reference with this caveat.
